text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear Trainer Kashimoto's 
instructions? "To strengthen team 
coordination, share information to deepen 
mutual understanding," she said.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
We've already shared the training data... 
which means he wants to delve into deeper 
matters.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go first! 'The truth is, I 
always hide 10kg weights in both of my 
shoes'!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Classic 'muscle brain' thinking. ...Is 
what I'd like to say, but...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever a new product comes out, I test 
it during self-training"— Unlike you, 
though, I tend to pick things based on 
design.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Still, picking things that way somehow 
makes it a lot more fun and competitive.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it! For me, it's— "Giving 
nicknames to my training gear to keep 
track of it"! It really makes you attached 
to them.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
And you take better care of them that way, 
too. Once I gave nicknames to the bunnies 
at the rabbit cafe, I cared about them 
even more.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp! Whaaaaaaat!?? T-That was just in 
the heat of the moment...!"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Oho, that's an unexpected thing in common! 
I shall keep that well in mind for mutual 
understanding!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Don't mess with me! Forget it already~~~!!
